test.fill_query: INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('test_parquet_top_k_file_order_{{_partition_id}}.parquet', Parquet) PARTITION BY intDiv(toUInt64(s), 250000) SELECT (number % 250000) + 250000 * ((intDiv(number, 250000) * 37 + 11) % 64) AS k, sipHash64(number) AS v, number % 1000 AS m, toString(number) AS s FROM numbers(16000000) SETTINGS output_format_parquet_row_group_size = 50000, max_block_size = 50000, max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1, engine_file_truncate_on_insert = 1
test.query: SELECT k, s FROM file('test_parquet_top_k_file_order_*.parquet') ORDER BY k LIMIT 10 SETTINGS max_threads = 4, max_parsing_threads = 4 FORMAT Null
